_about: Each database object belongs to the module whose migration created it. A migration declares its module on its first line (-- module: <name>) and lists any other module it changes (-- also: a, b). `npm run db:check` refuses a migration that changes another module's tables or functions without saying so, so one area can change without silently breaking another. Owners per module are in .github/CODEOWNERS.

core.about: Properties, rooms, room types, guests, reservations, stays, folios: the shared base every module builds on

access.about: Row security, roles, custom roles, privileges, who may do what

front-office.about: Booking, check-in and out, room moves, amendments and their charge previews

night-audit.about: End of day: room charges, no-shows, statistics, business date

reports.about: Every report and the group overview

cashiering.about: Folio tools, payments, drawers, city ledger, vouchers

back-office.about: POS, travel agents, exchange rates, packages and promotions

integrations.about: Channex, TTLock, Hikvision, fiscal receipts, Tenda ICO, eZee import, job queue

stock.about: Kitchen and bar stock, recipes, room assets

platform.about: Control panel, platform administrators, security hardening, property and user isolation

activities.about: Gym, pool, games, spa, tours: timers, memberships, door check-ins

operations.about: Setup lists, rate calendar, booking page, folio extras, POS for in-house guests

billing.about: BMG monthly subscriptions: invoices, locks, ClickPesa collection

pos.about: Full-service POS: menus, modifiers, tables, kitchen display, happy hours, split tender, end-of-day

procurement.about: Suppliers, store requests and issues, purchase orders, goods received, supplier invoices and payments

accounting.about: QuickBooks Online: connection, account mapping, sync of vendors, bills, payments and daily revenue

audit.about: Occupancy audit: camera sightings and door openings against check-ins, check-outs and payments; findings and their reports

guest-portal.about: Guest portal: private links sent at check-in, login keys, food orders and service requests, and the staff's live request list

platformManaged._about: Added to every table by the platform module; not counted as a change to the table's own module
